create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using a filepath and process rank
create_log_formatter: create a log formatter that adds elapsed time and level prefix to log records
create_pd_stats: create a pandas-based stats logger that persists rows to a pickle file
update_pd_stats: update a PD_Stats instance with a new row and optionally save to disk
reset_logger_time: reset the elapsed time tracking on a logger created by create_logger
